summary.text: Dimension is informally the minimum number of coordinates needed to specify any point in a space.
A line is one-dimensional, the surface of a sphere is two-dimensional, and the inside of a cube is three-dimensional.
For a vector space, the dimension is the number of vectors in any basis, which is the number of coordinates needed to specify any vector.

facts.label: A line
facts.value: One-dimensional, since one coordinate locates a point

facts.label: A vector space
facts.value: Dimension is the number of vectors in any basis

facts.label: Intrinsic
facts.value: Independent of the space an object sits inside

items.prompt: To say where a ship is on the ocean's surface, you give a latitude and a longitude. What does this say about the surface?
items.explain: A surface is two-dimensional because two coordinates are needed to specify a point on it.

items.prompt: An ant walks on a circular wire. One number, its distance along the wire from a mark, fixes its position. What is the circle's dimension?

options.label: One, even though the circle sits in a plane
Two, because the circle sits in a plane
Three, because the wire has thickness
Zero, because the circle is closed

items.explain: Dimension is intrinsic, so a curve like a circle has dimension one regardless of the space it is placed in.

items.prompt: What do you count to find the dimension of a vector space?

options.label: The elements in any one subspace
The largest coordinate any vector has
The scalars in the field it uses

items.explain: The dimension of a vector space is the number of vectors in any basis for it.

items.prompt: A flat sheet of paper is rolled into a tube inside a room. What is the dimension of the paper surface itself?

options.label: Three, since it sits in a 3D room
One, since it forms a tube

items.explain: A surface has dimension two even when it is embedded in three-dimensional space.

items.prompt: A speck is the whole object, and it has nowhere to slide in any direction. What is the dimension of a single point?
items.explain: The dimension of a point is zero, because a point on it cannot move in any direction.

items.prompt: An ant crawls on the skin of a ball, and a fly buzzes inside the ball. Which one needs more coordinates to say where it is?

options.label: Both, who need the same number
Neither, since the ball is round

items.explain: The surface of a sphere is two-dimensional, while the inside of a sphere is three-dimensional.
